title: health/servicenow/YYYY-MM-DDTHH-MM-SSZ.json
description: ServiceNow lab slip (Kind observation). Written on the first visit, when at least one in-scope ticket row moved against the board on health/metadata-servicenow.json (state, urgency, a typed entity column, rfc, issue, or any update), or when coverage is not complete. A quiet visit writes the board only. threads: one row per ticket that moved, same shape as a board row plus note. vs_prior.changed: one structured item per moved field. The typed columns (device, interface, ip, service, rfc) are the edges; no relations[]. Tickets do not vote on vitals: status is ok or unknown.

status.description: Collection only. ok when the incident query succeeded; unknown when coverage is unavailable. Open tickets never set this.

headline.description: Which tickets moved and how, how long the open ones have been open, whether any names a device or a change; then rows unchanged.

window.description: The since value passed in the query: active rows plus rows updated on or after it.

concerns.description: One incident entity-ref per active in-scope row whose priority or urgency is 1 or 2. Omit others.

metrics.description: One lab row: counts across the in-scope rows returned this visit. Nulls when collection failed.

threads.description: One row per in-scope ticket that moved this visit (every returned row on the first visit). Empty only when coverage is not complete or nothing is in scope.

unchanged.description: Board rows not replaced by a thread this visit. 0 on the first visit. null when unavailable.

prior_watch_id.description: Board last_visit_id at the start of this visit.

delta.description: worse: a new active row, a row reopened, or urgency raised. better: rows only moved to Resolved/Closed/Canceled and nothing worse. changed: any other item (typed field, rfc, issue, update). first on the baseline.

rows.description: In-scope rows returned this visit (incidents + changes).

open_incidents.description: Returned incident rows with active true.

open_p1p2.description: Open incidents whose priority or urgency starts with 1 or 2.

open_changes.description: Returned change rows with active true.

resolved_rows.description: Returned rows with active false (resolved, closed, or canceled since the window start).

typed_rows.description: Returned rows whose device column is non-empty. How many tickets carry a typed entity; a capability signal for the operator.

thread.description: Board row plus note. Every column is copied from one table row; keys are derived by the fixed rule in references/query.md.

scope.description: incident:<number> or change:<number>. Stable key for the board diff.

keys.description: incident:/change: for this row; device: from the device column or an inventory name in issue; interface:<device>/<interface> when both are set; service: from the service column, business_service, or a registry alias; change:<rfc> when rfc is set.

state.description: Display value as returned (New, In Progress, On Hold, Resolved, Closed, Canceled, ...).

urgency.description: Display value as returned, e.g. 2 - Medium.

priority.description: Display value as returned, e.g. 3 - Moderate.

updated_at.description: sys_updated_on. Moves on any edit including a work note.

resolved_at.description: resolved_at on incidents; closed_at on changes.

issue.description: short_description, verbatim. Never description or work notes.

rfc.description: Linked change number on an incident; null on changes.

service.description: The typed service column when the platform has one, else business_service display, else a registry name matched by alias; null when none.

device.description: The typed device column value as returned (metadata entity_fields.device); null when the platform has no such column or it is empty.

interface.description: The typed interface column value as returned.

ip.description: The typed ip column value as returned.

note.description: One sentence against the board row: what moved, how long open, whether a device or change is now attached. Not the columns again. No cause.
